newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS - Australia Senate rubber-stamps spending bills.
newsitem.headline: RTRS - Australia Senate rubber-stamps spending bills.

text.p: The Australian Senate passed the government's current appropriations bills late on Thursday, as it almost automatically does when they are presented to it.
The Senate's refusal to pass them would force a constitutional crisis.
With the Liberal-National administration pursuing budget cuts, the bills sought less money than non-government parties wanted to spend.

But even if the government's political opponents could have enlarged the expenditure authorisations by amending the bills -- which, constitutionally, they must not -- they cannot force the administration to actually spend the money.

Passage of the appropriations bills removes an item of business that had to be dealt with before the Senate moved on to the government's contentious budget bills, debate on which will proceed over the coming three weeks.
